question: Who presides over self-risen directions?
premises: He presides like the sun from varied body.
Even self-risen directions have own lords; Indra and others indeed preside.
inference: Varied-bodied Shiva presides, while directional lords preside over their own directions.
plain_english: He presides like the sun from varied body; even self-risen directions have own lords, and Indra and others indeed preside.
